hypothesis.mechanism:
BANKNIFTY index-option implied variance sits above subsequently realised variance
for the same reason NIFTY's does: index hedgers and structured-product desks buy
convexity with price insensitivity and somebody must warehouse it. BANKNIFTY
prices that warehousing differently — its constituents are one sector, its
realised volatility is higher, and since 2024-11-13 its front contract expires
monthly rather than weekly, which lengthens the decay window a short-variance
book sits inside. Whether the premium is best collected at the money, across a
band of strikes, with a bought tail, or only on sessions a conditioner selects,
is an empirical question about this corpus and not about the mechanism.

epochs.cross_epoch_justification:
THIS WINDOW CROSSES EVERY BOUNDARY M1'S WINDOW CROSSED, AND ONE MORE THAT IS BANKNIFTY'S
ALONE. M1's cross-epoch argument is in research/m1/gate.toml and is not restated. What is
added here is the boundary specific to this product:

  BANKNIFTY WEEKLY EXPIRIES WERE CULLED ON 2024-11-13. From that date the product has a
  MONTHLY front contract only. Before it, weekly.

That is not a rate change. It changed how often the traded object exists, which changes the
number of cycles a hold-n straddle can open in a year, which changes annualisation itself.
Roughly six weeks of this 20-month window sit on the weekly side of that line and the rest
on the monthly side, so the pooled series is overwhelmingly a monthly-expiry series with a
short weekly prologue.

SO WHY POOL AT ALL, on M1's own reasoning: splitting would burn a trial per sub-window
against a family already carrying 107, deflate every resulting Sharpe further, hand the
researcher a post-hoc choice of which regime to believe, and leave the weekly side with
far too few cycles to carry a Sharpe worth reading. The pooled verdict is the honest form
of the question, and the question is worth an answer.

WHAT THE POOLED NUMBER THEREFORE MEANS, stated in advance: it describes a
monthly-expiry BANKNIFTY straddle book with a weekly prologue attached, weighted by session
count. It is NOT a statement about the weekly-expiry regime, and none will be claimed.
